original: Alice awoke early. Birds sang outside. Coffee brewed slowly. Dogs barked twice. Every neighbor waved. Fog covered town. Grandma baked bread. Her kitchen smelled sweet. Its warmth spread. Joy filled hearts. Kids ran around. Laughter echoed loudly. Mothers chatted happily. Nobody felt lonely. Old friends arrived. Puppies played nearby. Quiet returned later. Rain began falling. Soon everyone left. The house grew still. Under blankets, Alice read. Very late, she slept. Wind howled softly. Xylophones chimed in dreams. Yesterday faded away. Zebras danced in her sleep.
